capabilities: Read RSS/Atom feeds and Markdown files in the vault
Translate Chinese articles into Vietnamese while reading
Save article links or selected quotes into the daily note
Group feed sources and import or export subscriptions as OPML
Cache downloaded images inside the vault
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. All read data, saved items and subscriptions stay inside the vault; GPL-3.0-only license; installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in feed reader, so reading feeds and logging articles into daily notes requires leaving the vault.
summary: RSS reader that fetches RSS/Atom feeds in the vault, translates Chinese articles into Vietnamese, and saves links to the daily note.
